title: Chapter 263 - 263 The Concert Began; Lively Venue!

Chapter 263 - 263 The Concert Began; Lively Venue!

Chapter 263 - 263 The Concert Began; Lively Venue!

263 The Concert Began; Lively Venue!

In the next moment…

The originally dark stage suddenly shot out 20 dazzling pillars of light.

At the same time, ten high-end, magnificent, and cool Rolls-Royce Phantoms appeared on the huge stage.

Rolls-Royce Phantoms! Each was worth ten million!

Ten cars meant 100 million!

Most ordinary people might not even see one in their lifetime.

At this moment, a total of ten cars had appeared!

The stadium was immediately filled with exclamations.

“F*ck! Rolls-Royce Phantoms!”

“Moreover, there are ten of them!”

“So cool!”

“Using Rolls-Royce Phantoms as the light, how awesome!”

…

These exclamations did not only appear in the stadium.

The audience outside the hall also exclaimed loudly.

This was because a huge high-definition display screen of more than 100 square meters suddenly appeared in front of the originally pitch-black area.

Although they could not see the ten Rolls-Royce Phantoms at the scene, through the huge high-definition display screen, the outline and details of the Rolls-Royce Phantoms could be seen more clearly.

On the display screen, the light beams formed by the 20 headlights looked more like 20 laser beams that cut through the night, adding a dreamy color to the stage.

Just as countless viewers were exclaiming in amazement…

A woman in a white muslin dress slowly rose from the stage. She only stopped when she was a few meters above the stage.

She… was today’s main character, Ling Rou.

Rumble!

At the same time, a helicopter suddenly appeared in the sky and shot out a dazzling beam of light that landed on Ling Rou.

The white muslin dress on her body was as dazzling as the stars.

This dress was actually inlaid with countless diamonds!

Seeing this…

The audience exclaimed again.

“Heavens! So beautiful!”

“Is this a fairy?”

“They’re actually using a helicopter as a stage light. Isn’t this too extravagant?”

“Furthermore, it’s not an ordinary helicopter. It’s an MD902 worth 45 million!”

“The dress she’s wearing seems to be the work of a famous Louis Vuitton designer, Lawrence. It’s called Star!”

“That’s right! It’s Star! I saw it at the International Fashion Exhibition Center in Country F not long ago! This dress is inlaid with 365 diamonds, and the total value is more than 10 million US dollars!”

…

At this moment, the entire stadium was filled with a burst of light music.

The music surrounded the audience and made them feel as if they were wearing headphones. It was extremely enjoyable.

Some people shouted again.

“FM Acoustics! It’s FM Acoustics! Heavens! This concert is actually using FM Acoustics’ sound system!”

“Is this audio system very expensive?” someone asked.

“Is it very expensive? Don’t you know? FM Acoustics’ is the world’s top audio system. If a car needs to be equipped with FM Acoustics, it would cost at least a million yuan! And a large-scale sound system for a concert like this would cost at least 20 million? No!

“Maybe 50 million!”

Everyone around gasped.

A set of speakers cost 50 million?

Oh my God, this had completely exceeded their imaginations.

At this moment, the prelude music ended. Ling Rou, who was standing on the stage, slowly opened her willow-shaped lips.

“The trees in the mountains form a forest, the curved stream flows, the handsome man wields a long sword, and the fallen leaves do not touch his body…”

Her singing was light and free… With the help of FM Acoustics’ sound system, it was as if the audience was depicting the wonderful life of an ancient chivalrous woman in the minds of the audience.

At this moment, the audience seemed to have been transported into a world of ancient martial arts. They saw with their own eyes the swordswoman dancing as he eliminated evil, becoming famous all over the world!

Everyone was intoxicated by it and could not extricate themselves.

The song came to an end after a melodious tune.

The moment the music stopped, thunderous applause erupted.

Ling Rou listened to the audience’s enthusiastic applause and looked at the excited expressions of the audience. Her beautiful eyes were faintly glistening with tears.

She had successfully held a concert and won everyone’s favor.

Then, Ling Rou looked around the audience.

Soon, her gaze landed on Lin Fan, who was sitting at the front.

Ling Rou understood that all of this… was because of Lin Fan.

After the applause stopped, Ling Rou said, “Thank you for your applause.”

“My name is Ling Rou, and I’ve liked martial arts since I was young. I used to buy martial arts manuals from street stalls and secretly practice them at home.

“After a month of seclusion, I felt that my martial arts had already reached great success. Therefore, I ran out to fight with the boy who had bullied me in the past. In the end… I was beaten up until I cried.”

The audience did not expect the beauty on stage to have such an experience. They could not help but laugh.

Ling Rou was also very satisfied with everyone’s reaction and continued, “Later on, I finally understood something. I shouldn’t be a martial arts genius. I wouldn’t be able to become a martial arts expert.

“I could only imagine myself as a martial arts expert, which was how I came to compose ‘Sword Dance’.”

There was another round of applause.

Qiu Ziqian, who was sitting in the front row, praised, “Is this our other sister? She’s too beautiful, and her singing is so good! Moreover, she actually knows how to tell stories. How amazing!”

Lin Fan almost choked on his own saliva. He explained, “I don’t have that kind of relationship with her.”

“Really? It doesn’t matter. There’ll be that kind of relationship in the future anyway,” Qiu Ziqian said.

The surrounding women nodded in agreement.

…

At this moment, Ling Rou, who was standing on stage, said, “Later on, my mother told me that girls should be quiet instead of always wanting to fight… In this way, there would be a prince riding a white horse who would dote on me like a princess in the future.

“However, this prince never appeared. So, I wrote another song, ‘I Am the Princess’!”

A burst of pleasant music rang out in the spacious gymnasium again.

“The fairy tale book in the cabinet, the happiness of enjoying it alone, I had many feelings when I was young…

“I put on a gorgeous gown, walked into a gorgeous palace, and held the prince’s hand to sing and dance…”

Different from the previous carefree and elegant song, the melody of this song was more brisk and leisurely.

With the help of the FM Acoustics’ sound system and the helicopter lights, Ling Rou seemed to have really become a noble princess.

Everyone felt as if they were in a gorgeous banquet hall. They watched as Princess Ling Rou and a tall and handsome prince swayed gently to elegant music.

Everything was so wonderful.

The music stopped, and the audience once again burst into enthusiastic applause.
